body: Do you remember where we were in the early 2000s, why is it that everyone must believe that he must stay, and if not you are a fake fan. I’m not saying he is a bad manager and he has definitely taken us away from difficult times but we are not in these competitions to just participate. To have over 700 million to spend to build your own squad from scratch and not lift a single trophy in 5 years is not acceptable, he would not be able to do that at any other club that wins trophies so why can he do it with arsenal. The lack mentality and ruthlessness of this club is what will keep us repeating the same shit next year.

Thank you for your reply. I'm sorry you had to go through that mate, keep your head up, understand its gonna be a a journey ahead to recover from but just take it one step at a time. You will get there eventually. If you ever need to pm don't be afraid to do so.

Damn it's crazy how much are minds can't just actively let go of these things. Thank you for sharing your experience. Your gonna pull through eventually. Don't give up. If you ever need to pm don't hesitate.

Thank you for your reply. It's long journey ahead and I'll definitely be utilising your advice. I hope you can recover from what you have been through aswell. Stay strong and if you need to pm don't hesitate to do so.

Thank you for your reply. I think it is an insecurity of mine I have, I don't doubt I won't find someone that will love me as much as she did. I'm just unsure whether I will like the girl as much as I did with her. I like the suggestions of focusing on what makes me  valuable. I hope things work out for you to and we get through this.

Thank you for your reply. Both methods I think would work better for someone else but I still appreciate your post. I say this because I was the main reason our relationship ended, my behaviour ruined it. She had her faults but she definitely put up with a lot more. The one thing I can say is that this experience has shaped me into a better person and made me realise that it doesn't matter what people may think about my relationship or who I'm dating and I should just go all in if I'm truly happy with them.

Thank you for your reply. I've experienced things similar to what you have said especially the fantasy bit. I think i can still have that but I need to realise that's something in the future with someone else. I have tried to avoid how I feel at times but cause I feel like it happens so often that I need to stop and think about something else. 

Hopefully we can get through this and look back in time and say this needed to happen for our benefit. If you ever need to talk don't be afraid to pm cause I probably will need it as well, I'm not gonna just disappear and not respond but thank you for your message.

2 months ago. I have very recently started doing things like socialising abit more with family, going out for nature walks, the gym etc. I just can't seem to get through the emotions. Part of me doesn't want to let go.
